full_name: Nancy E. Hill | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Social Sciences Suzanne Young Murray Professor Harvard Graduate School of Education
bio: Nancy E. Hill is a professor at the Harvard Graduate School of Education and the Suzanne Young Murray Professor at the Radcliffe Institute. Her research focuses on cultural, economic, and community influences on family socialization patterns that in turn shape child and adolescent development and achievement.
